upstream.description: Hands-on labs for extending Microsoft 365 Copilot and building custom engine agents

classification.analysis: Microsoft's official hands-on workshop repo for building and extending Microsoft 365 Copilot: declarative agents, custom-engine agents (M365 Agents SDK + Semantic Kernel, or Agent Framework), Copilot Cowork extensibility, MCP servers with Entra ID auth, and SharePoint agents. Structured as multiple bundled lab tracks (A-E) with full C#/TypeScript/Bicep sample projects (e.g. an insurance-claims agent with vision analysis and document search) for enterprise developers on the Microsoft stack.

use_cases.title: Follow guided labs to build a Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent
Build a custom-engine agent with the M365 Agents SDK and Semantic Kernel
Secure an MCP server with OAuth 2.0 and Entra ID
Ground a Copilot agent in enterprise data via Copilot Connectors
